summary: Removes the SimpleLazyObject wrapper that caused URL kwargs to remain unresolved lazy objects (crashing DB queries), returning plain values instead — correctly resolves the crash. Matches Django's actual resolution (un-deprecating URL-kwargs-in-context); only leftover cruft is the now-pointless closure.

issues.description: Leftover `def access_value(value=value): return value` then `context_kwargs[key] = access_value()` is a pointless closure; could be simplified to `context_kwargs[key] = value`. Harmless but unnecessary indirection.

Silently drops the RemovedInDjango40Warning deprecation notice for passing URL kwargs to context. This is intentional/aligned with the ticket's decision to un-deprecate, but worth noting the removed user-facing warning.
